Scope and remaining work Cold-plasma oscillation with electrostatic CIC PIC: Finite amplitude and finite particles leave an error floor. Nonlinear instabilities, Landau damping, collisions, electromagnetic/relativistic PIC and open particle boundaries are unvalidated. PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise: DOP853 is not an independent PIC spatial implementation. Distinguish charge/momentum preservation from approximate energy conservation. Initial-noise N scaling does not validate evolved warm plasmas. Landau damping, electromagnetic/relativistic PIC and collisions remain unvalidated.
